title: Ultrafiltration, Hemoperfusion and Hemofiltration
benefit_category: Inpatient Hospital Services, Institutional Dialysis Services and Supplies, Outpatient Hospital Services Incident to a Physician's Service
revision_history: <p>    08/1987 - Revised to indicate that hemoperfusion is not covered when used in conjunction with deferoxamine (DFO) to remove iron overload and is covered when used in conjunction with DFO to treat aluminum toxicity.  Also revised to cover hemofiltration for renal patients. Effective date 08/20/1987. (TN 18)</p>
